description: This file provides database utility functions for establishing connections and executing queries using psycopg in a PostgreSQL context. It handles environment variable configuration, connection management, and common database operations like fetch and execute.

methods.name: str _build_dsn_from_env()
methods.description: Builds a PostgreSQL DSN string from environment variables or a provided URL, raising an error if required variables are missing.

methods.name: get_conn()
methods.description: Context manager that yields a psycopg connection object, ensuring proper closing.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the database and returns it as a dictionary, or None if no rows are returned.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Fetches all rows resulting from a query and returns them as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: None execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a data modification statement (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and commits the transaction.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] execute_returning_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a statement that returns a single row, raising an error if no row is returned.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> None:$/

ctags.name: execute_returning_one
ctags.pattern: /^def execute_returning_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
